action: Trace request-scoped protocolVersion/clientCapabilities precedence versus initialized peer/session state in pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk source.
result: At pinned rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, RequestContext<RoleServer>::protocol_version reads the current request metadata first and falls back to peer_info.protocol_version only when the request metadata accessor yields None. RequestContext<RoleServer>::client_capabilities is stricter for request-metadata-required sessions: it returns only the current request metadata value and does not fall back to peer_info; for legacy sessions it reads request metadata first and then falls back to peer_info.capabilities. Therefore the accessor layer gives well-typed per-request protocolVersion metadata precedence over initialized peer state, and gives per-request clientCapabilities exclusive authority when request metadata is required. No equality or consistency comparison against peer_info is present in these accessor bodies; this receipt does not claim that no such check exists elsewhere in the receive/dispatch path.
